jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION OBJECTIVE:

The position objective of a Financial Analyst Specialist is to provide accurate financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic insights to support executive decision-making, participate in raising debt financing for projects, improve financial performance, and ensure effective financial planning and control.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Develop and maintain financial models for planning and decision-making.
Evaluating capital expenditure and investment proposals.
Assist in structuring debt deals and execution processes, including financing documentations, until disbursement.
Monitor existing loan portfolio, covenants compliance and relationships with financing partners.
Assist in drafting commercial terms in legal agreements with operating partners.
Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior management.
Support strategic planning and business case evaluations.
Participate in annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes.
Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
Collaborate with department heads to support financial performance.
Improve financial reporting processes and internal controls.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
Assist in developing dashboards and performance tracking tools.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Academic:

– Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
– Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, CFA are an added advantage.
Experience:

– 3+ years of relevant experience in financial analysis, budgeting, or corporate finance.
– Experience with financial modeling, debt financing, forecasting, and reporting Exposure to cross-functional projects and strategic business support Experience in using ERP systems or financial software.

Skills :

• Strong financial analysis and reporting abilities
• Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills
• Knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS)
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Good understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
• Experience with financial software and dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Budget: EGP 25,000–30,000, DEPENDING ON EXPERIENCE IN FINANCIAL ANALYST.

jobs.title: IT Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
Cretik is a Dubai-based software house, founded in 2020, that delivers bespoke software, mobile applications, UI/UX, websites, and e-commerce solutions across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the wider MENA region. The company focuses on creating intuitive, visually compelling digital products that help clients exceed industry standards and strengthen their competitive advantage. Cretik’s professional team collaborates closely with businesses to understand their specific needs and deliver tailored technology solutions. The organization values innovation, high-quality design, and reliable execution in every project, offering team members opportunities to work on diverse and impactful digital products.
Role Description
The IT Risk Analyst is a full-time, hybrid role based in Qesm El Maadi, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The role involves identifying, assessing, and monitoring technology and cybersecurity risks across Cretik’s systems, applications, and infrastructure. Daily responsibilities include conducting risk assessments, reviewing controls, analyzing incident reports, and preparing clear documentation and recommendations for risk mitigation. The IT Risk Analyst collaborates with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed risk management practices into project lifecycles and support compliance with internal policies and relevant standards. The role also includes tracking remediation activities, maintaining risk registers, and contributing to continuous improvement of IT governance, security posture, and business continuity planning.
Qualifications

Strong skills in IT risk assessment, risk analysis, and risk reporting; ability to identify control gaps and propose practical mitigation measures.
Knowledge of information security principles, cybersecurity best practices, and relevant frameworks or standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS) is highly beneficial.
Experience with IT governance, policies, and procedures, including incident management, access management, and change management processes.
Competence in analyzing technical documentation, system architectures, and data flows to understand risk exposure and dependencies.
Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise risk reports and explain complex issues to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and operate effectively in a hybrid work environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CRISC, CISA, CISSP) are a plus.
Previous experience in IT risk, information security, or audit within a technology, software, or digital services environment is preferred.
